posts.name: Envisioner
posts.cooked:
Technically, the Talisman was at 2 HP, so Bunker destroyed it (aka stole it...with a grenade).  But yeah, we curbstomped her.  You shoulda let me keep having her defend with sharks, so it'd be more sporting.  :P

Good game.  handshake

PS:  There are indeed only 2 Temporal Grenades in CR's deck.  But if you'd really wanted the Glass Jaw gone, you could have had Bunker shoot CR for 4 with the Grenade (3 would still have been enough to steal the Talisman, and you could have used its power second since the Flak Cannon was overkill).  That way, the text of Kismet: Charmed Scoundrel would have destroyed one Jinx, and you'd have gotten to amuse yourself by looking at a deck.

Villain reduced to -20 in one round...that's definitely a personal record in my experience.
